capabilities.summary: Live whole-disk file index: getattrlistbulk crawl, FSEvents upkeep, fuzzy name search, and clone- and hard-link-aware folder size rollups (logical, allocated, allocated-unique).
policyNotes: Name search and folder sizes only; content search is an opt-in cargo feature that is off by default.
No precise implementation fingerprint; declaration-only inventory, never enforced ownership or verified integration.
